title: Open a Client Project from its bridge address, and a clean palette
as: A consultant starting on a new client from nothing but the bridge's Git address
goal: From an empty window, open the synthetic client from its bridge address, then check that the DataPass commands and settings carry no client-specific or retired names.
hints: Command Palette → DataPass: Open a Client Project… → paste https://github.com/julian-passebecq/codex-datapass-bridge.
When DataPass asks for a folder, choose this journey's scratch folder named in the prompt (it is empty).
In the Command Palette type DataPass and scroll the whole list; in Settings (Ctrl+,) search mongoku, then foil.
expected: DataPass clones the bridge and the client's repositories into the scratch folder and opens one window for the client, with the bridge and its repositories.
Typing DataPass in the Command Palette gives a short, readable list with no command that mentions FOIL or Mongoku.
Searching Settings for mongoku finds no DataPass setting; searching for foil finds none either.
outOfScope: Cloud sign-in or any cloud command offered by the opened project
